children: GL Part SPV II, LLC disclosed a 6.7% stake in XCF Global, Inc.'s common stock. The filing dated Sep. 15, 2026 details share acquisitions tied to a 2025 business combination and a warrant exercise on Sep. 14, 2026. The position highlights an ongoing deal framework that could expand GL Part SPV II’s ownership through additional warrants.

GL Part SPV II can increase its position through a Warrant Purchase Agreement signed on July 16, 2026. The firm "has the right to acquire... up to $100,000,000" of additional warrants until Dec. 31, 2026, with each warrant exercisable at $2.50 per share.

The investor also executed a warrant for 6,891,798 shares on Sep. 14, 2026 and may adjust its holdings as it sees fit. It "may purchase and sell common stock of XCF in their sole discretion," subject to law.

GL Part SPV II, LLC is an investment vehicle based in Sheridan, Wyoming, that focuses on XCF Global and other companies in the sustainable aviation fuel sector. The firm targets energy transition themes and special situations that can use structured capital such as warrants. It reports no relevant legal proceedings and operates as a discretionary investor.
